description: Retrieval test set for the TrackFlow knowledge base (contexts/RAG-briefing.md, sections 4-5). A question counts as a hit when one of its top-3 retrieved chunks comes from expected.source_document and contains expected.text_contains (compared after whitespace normalisation). out_of_scope questions have no answer in the corpus; their best scores are used to choose the similarity threshold, never to compute Recall@3. Scored by scripts/evaluate_rag_retrieval.py.

queries.question: What delivery SLA does TrackFlow commit to in the standard contract?

expected.text_contains: 90% on-time deliveries per month

queries.question: What compensation does a client get if on-time deliveries fall below the SLA?

expected.text_contains: 5% compensation on that country's monthly fee

queries.question: How long does express shipping take, and where is it available?

expected.text_contains: Express shipping: 24 to 48 hours

queries.question: Can we guarantee our client's delivery times during Black Friday?

expected.text_contains: does not guarantee delivery SLA during declared high-demand dates

queries.question: How much longer can deliveries take during the January Sales in Spain?

expected.text_contains: up to an additional 40%

queries.question: What's the standard return window?

expected.text_contains: Standard return window: 30 days from delivery

queries.question: Who pays the shipping cost when an end customer returns a product?

expected.text_contains: the return shipping cost is covered by the client brand

queries.question: A customer bought an item in the United States and wants to return it in Spain. Is that handled automatically?

expected.text_contains: International returns (purchased in one country, returned in another)

queries.question: How does the returns process work, from the customer's request to the warehouse inspection?

expected.text_contains: The end customer requests a return through the brand's portal

queries.question: Which carrier best covers rural Aragón?

expected.text_contains: SEUR: best coverage in rural areas of Aragón

queries.question: Which carrier do we use for heavy packages in the United States?

expected.text_contains: UPS: full national coverage, best rate for heavy packages

queries.question: Can an account manager pick a different carrier for a client's shipment?

expected.text_contains: except for an exception approved by Carlos Vega

queries.question: How are storage fees calculated?

expected.text_contains: charges client brands for storage based on volume occupied

queries.question: Can we offer a storage discount to a client that stores 60 cubic meters a month?

expected.text_contains: can negotiate a preferential rate

queries.question: Can a client get a report of how long their inventory has been sitting in the warehouse?

expected.text_contains: inventory aging report

queries.question: What delivery times do we commit to for standard shipments?

expected.text_contains: Standard shipping: 3 to 5 business days

queries.question: Can I promise a prospect next-day delivery during Christmas?

expected.text_contains: does not guarantee delivery SLA during declared high-demand dates

queries.question: How long does a customer have to send a product back?

expected.text_contains: Standard return window: 30 days from delivery

queries.question: My client needs us to use a carrier we don't normally work with for one route. Can we do that?

expected.text_contains: except for an exception approved by Carlos Vega

queries.question: Who approves a preferential storage rate?

expected.text_contains: that negotiation must always go through Miguel Torres
